ben: heads-up — after the keepalive align tweak deployed at 09:50UTC i'm seeing a small spike of disconnected streaming clients in eu-west1 starting ~10:13. looks like ping vs route-swap race.

carol: paste an example log + region pls

ben: sure — eu-west1. snippet: ```
2026-03-18T10:13:02Z proxy-2 INFO  route_swap start route_id=rc-42 conn_id=abcd1234
2026-03-18T10:13:02Z proxy-2 DEBUG schedule PING seq=17 conn_id=abcd1234 delay_ms=4100
2026-03-18T10:13:02Z proxy-2 WARN  conn_close reason=keepalive_window_jumpstart route_swap=true conn_id=abcd1234
```

dave: yup that matches the race we worried about. aggressive-align causes pings to be rescheduled and if a route_swap lands it triggers the hard-close.

emily: our metrics just show `timeout` for disconnects — we can't distinguish jumpstart vs normal idle. need better tags in telemetry.

ben: agreed. quick mitigation: rollback the align change on the canary?

dave: i can roll it back in 10m. downside: routing efficiency drop.

carol: meanwhile can we soft-fail instead of closing? e.g. if route_swap pending within 250ms of ping, postpone send by jitter(50..200ms) and emit metric `keepalive_postponed`.

ben: pseudo: ```
if (route_swap_inflight(conn, 250ms)) {
  sleep(random_ms(50,200))
  if (!route_swap_inflight(conn, 0)) send_ping(conn)
  else emit_counter("keepalive_postponed")
} else send_ping(conn)
```

dave: that seems safe. i'll rollback canary now and then we can ship the jitter guard in a follow-up.

emily: telemetry tasks: 1) add `disconnect_reason` label to stream.disconnects counter (values: timeout, keepalive_window_jumpstart, route_swap, client), 2) add trace attr `routing.swap_age_ms`, 3) add `route_swap` boolean to proxy logs. estimate 2-3h.

carol: filing console ticket for new filters + heatmap: reconnect_latency by region+model. linking product.

deploy-bot: deploy event: rollback start author=dave environment=canary started_at=2026-03-18T10:30:00Z

dave: rollback started 10:30 UTC. will watch metrics for 10m.

ben: when watching, look at `stream.disconnects{disconnect_reason=keepalive_window_jumpstart}` and `stream.reconnect_latency.p95`. also check if console still shows many `timeout` entries — that was confusing.

emily: will open a small PR for trace/log attrs after lunch and link it here.

carol: console ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGPLAT-9876 — includes filter and heatmap mock.

dave: rollback complete 10:32UTC. initial disconnects down ~85% in the first 3min. monitoring until 10:50.

ben: summary: rollout introduced ping vs route-swap race -> forced closes labeled as timeouts in console. actions: rollback (done), telemetry changes (emily), jitter-postpone guard (dave+ben), console filters (carol).

carol: added runbook note: if a release correlates with >5/min timeout spikes, check `route_swap` log field and consider rolling back canary. snippet added.

ben: thanks all — ping me in DMs if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
